`run: email` + `with: { to, subject, template | html | text, data }`. `template: <name>` renders emails/<name>.html as the HTML body (mustache; full flow context + the `data:` map overlaid on top - `data: {org_name: "${{ steps.org.outputs.name }}"}` makes `{{org_name}}` resolve in the template). Bare names need no extension; `templates/<name>.html` and literal app-relative paths also resolve. Frontmatter is stripped.

`html:` (alias `body:`) is an inline HTML body - no template file needed. `text:` is the plain-text part (alone = text-only send, alongside html = multipart/alternative). `vars:` is an alias for `data:`. to/subject/html/text and data values all interpolate `${{ ... }}` refs.
A body is REQUIRED: a step whose template can't be found, or with neither template nor inline html/text, fails the step LOUD with the tried paths.

Delivery: the platform email service on the hosted platform (zero config); off-platform SMTP_HOST/PORT/USER/PASS (AWS SES SMTP creds). EMAIL_FROM sets the sender (must be a verified domain on the platform). Same delivery path as hook emails (`email:` in hooks.yaml, which resolves emails/<name>.html the same way).

`from:` overrides EMAIL_FROM for ONE send ("send as" - e.g. mail that should come from the rep who triggered the flow, so replies reach them); `reply_to:` sets Reply-To. Both interpolate `${{ ... }}`. The from-DOMAIN is enforced, not suggested: it must be a domain verified for THIS app (the same verification EMAIL_FROM needs - `benmore email-domain <app> add <domain>`), and apps on the shared platform domain always send as <app-sub>@mail.benmore.ai. An unauthorized from-domain FAILS the step with a message naming the domain - it never quietly falls back to EMAIL_FROM.
